reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Both depict the named angelic character but the sculpture/pose is different: canonical cover shows ornate pale gold and silver armor, both arms extended outward, wide pale tendril wings and a dark rocky/lava pedestal. Source views 1–4 show a hooded brown/gray-robed figure with sword held low, one arm relaxed, a flat glowing circular base and a densely branching gold light-wing halo with distinct curves. The canonical cover's ornate layered armor, limb positions, wings and base do not match. One current name candidate cannot exclude every historical Diablo variant.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Human visual comparison of physical sculpture, geometry, pose and base. Verified SHA-256 source bytes and public R2 cover; perceptual hash is corroboration only and never automatic identity proof.

mediaReview.notes: Source images and cover have distinct third-party artist logos and Patreon/creator marks; creator rights are not established by same-character imagery. Never import/crop/retouch branded source assets or replace published cover from identity decision.

decision.nextGate: Read-only search of historical aliases and other same-franchise published variants; do not approve new model from one distinct current name match.
